caption: The drawing depicts a square textile design with a predominantly dark red or burgundy background. At the center, there is a large pink flower with visible petals and brownish-green leaves. The flower and leaves are detailed with shading in shades of pink, yellow, brown, and green. Surrounding the central flower, there is an ornate, symmetrical border that forms a square frame, rendered in shades of gray, green, white, and light pink. This border consists of curving, ribbon-like and geometric shapes that resemble stylized acanthus leaves and scrolls, interspersed with oval decorative sections. In each of the four outer corners, there is a stylized green leaf motif positioned within the frame. The overall composition has a pixelated, patterned appearance typical of needlepoint or tapestry designs. The drawing is centered on a beige or off-white background, with a hand-written name “Erwin Schwabe” in the lower right corner.
title: Needlepoint and Beadwork Square
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
